description: This file contains setup and test scripts for verifying the behavior of the 'bundle-uri' command in protocol v2. It configures different download protocols (file, git, http), initializes git repositories, and performs various tests to ensure correct handling of bundle URIs and protocol features during git operations.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites for the tests based on the protocol.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_uri_escape
methods.description: Escapes the URI for safe transmission.

methods.name: test_cmp_config_output
methods.description: Compares the actual output to the expected configuration output.

methods.name: test_tool bundle-uri
methods.description: Runs the 'bundle-uri' command to inspect bundle URI configuration.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets git configuration for testing purposes.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Starts a git daemon for testing.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server for testing HTTP protocol interactions.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.
